name: Under-Door Tool (UDT)
description: The under-door tool is inserted under the door gap and manipulates a lever handle or thumb turn on the interior side from outside the door. It is highly effective on lever-handle doors with interior egress hardware and is one of the most reliable bypass techniques against commercial lever hardware. The tool requires approximately 1cm of clearance under the door and works on a wide range of commercial configurations. An air wedge can supplement clearance on tighter doors.

blue.det: Door open alert if door state monitored; camera coverage of entry point; marks under door from tool.
blue.cm: Door bottom seals reducing clearance below 1cm; door alarms on all access-controlled doors; camera coverage of entry points from angles showing under-door approach.
